waterfall_definition.entry_execution: R1 actual-entry gross minus R0 modeled net, normalized by runtime risk
waterfall_definition.profit_protection: R2 dynamic P1 gross minus R1 static actual-entry gross when a real replacement event exists
waterfall_definition.trigger_to_fill_slippage: R3 actual gross minus R2 modeled gross
waterfall_definition.commission: R3 actual net minus R3 actual gross
waterfall_definition.unknown_residual: Measured protection effect withheld when simulation triggered but no runtime replacement event exists
waterfall_definition.zero_buckets: No price effect assigned without an authoritative exchange or replay measurement
